lookback_summary: Well, what a weekend of Premier League action! The model was on point with several predictions, nailing the draw in the Fulham vs Man United match and correctly calling Man City's win over Sunderland. However, it had to eat humble pie when it came to Everton, who managed a home win against Ipswich despite the model predicting otherwise. Leeds and Crystal Palace ended in a stalemate, catching the model off guard, while Brighton’s convincing victory over Arsenal was another miss. Overall, the model had its moments but also some surprise results that no one saw coming!
